mechanism: Torsemide-induced electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hyponatremia) increases tricyclic antidepressant cardiotoxicity and arrhythmia risk; nortriptyline's anticholinergic effects may worsen fluid/electrolyte imbalances.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes regularly, maintain adequate potassium levels, monitor ECG for QT prolongation, and consider alternative diuretic if clinically feasible.
